$comment: The ONE canonical orchestration policy of the Udgam maths pipeline (every class). Read by orch.mjs (gates, plans, tiered checks, checkpoints), usage.mjs (budgets, simulate), classctl.mjs (each agent file's `model:` line and the escalated twins) and the cli.mjs hooks (check cache keys, runtime freeze gates). A class overrides any key in class<N>/pipeline.config.json under "orchestration" (deep merge: objects merge, arrays and scalars replace). Change a model here, then regenerate the agents: node classctl.mjs sync --from <M> --to <N> --only agents (dry run, then --apply on the owner's word). See udgam_maths_claude.md "Orchestration" and TOKENS.md.

models.$comment: Claude Code agent aliases (opus | sonnet | haiku | inherit) per role and stage. 'main' is advice for the session itself (/model), not a file. Opus only for: planning, difficult maths, pattern representatives, runtime work across tools, reviewer-conflict arbitration (routing below).

routing.$comment: Which tier a launch uses. 'escalated' = the <role>-escalated twin (models above). A follower builder starts on the base tier; it escalates only on a trigger.

limits.$comment: Per chapter build. A number is fixed; { base, perTool } is base + perTool x tools, rounded up. orch gate refuses a launch past a limit (exit 3).

batching.$comment: Items per agent. orch plan picks the size (1..max) with the lowest modelled context cost that keeps every agent under contextBudget.targetTokens and the chapter under its agent limits.

contextBudget.$comment: Context is the cost driver (every call re-reads it). targetTokens: plan every agent under it. escalateTokens: a running agent past it is checkpointed and continued fresh, never resumed by SendMessage. Soft caps are what an agent can count itself.

checks.$comment: Tier 0 metadata, 1 quick (check --no-render), 2 one full check of a changed tool, 3 real-input play for new or risky interactions, 4 visual pack when visual changes justify it. A cached result is reused only when every key part matches.

review.$comment: Deduplication: maths on every tool (round 1), later rounds only where the maths digest changed; visual and play in full on each NEW pattern's representative; a repeat of an unchanged pattern gets a light visual pass (upgraded to full on a visual check WARN/FAIL or a new picture kind) and no play test unless risky; a re-review looks only at changed frames and named probes.

runtimeGates.$comment: Programmatic batching of runtime moves (runbook non-negotiable 3). `runtime freeze|pin` must name --ch N and --gate. prereview and postplay once each per chapter build; blocker only with --proof (a real-input probe), at most maxBlocker; step6 = a pin to the newest head at a chapter's own step 6. `freeze rN` (restore) is free; --ungated "why" is logged.

session.$comment: Session-limit guard. Claude Code does not expose the plan's percentage on disk, so orch gate uses the freshest of (a) the owner's reading (node orch.mjs session --pct 72, from /usage) and (b) a rolling-window estimate from local transcripts against budgetUsd5h (list-price-weighted; calibrate once: node usage.mjs window --calibrate <pct shown by /usage>). Unset budget and no reading = only the agent-count fallback.

estimates.$comment: The cost model of usage.mjs simulate (MODEL ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements: calibrate with `usage.mjs simulate --from <usage report.json>` once real transcripts exist). calls = model calls an agent makes; grow = tokens its context gains per call; start sizes are measured from the class's files.
